question: Measure actual repeated words/phrases beyond Allah-name forms, without selecting ink colors; test spacing sensitivity preserving actual text/order.
inventory: All canonical scanned verse words, excluding Fatiha and synthetic head basmalas. Exact spelling from the frozen same-word study; prefixes and hamza distinctions retained. Phrases are contiguous 2..6-word windows inside a single verse, with at least two canonical occurrences anywhere. Single words include the full canonical inventory.
location: All constituent words must be mapped on one page and one seeded row, in strictly decreasing RTL centers. Missing, page-split, row-split and reversed-order windows remain explicitly accounted for. Partners must be on distinct rows of one page.

scoring.primary: Each phrase occurrence is aligned once iff an identical phrase has ALL corresponding word centers within 15px. Single words use the same endpoint rule.
scoring.secondary: Phrase-hull center within 15px, reported descriptively; does not certify individual word correspondence.
scoring.primary_groups: Six separate lengths 1..6 excluding any occurrence whose identity contains an Allah-name form under the canonical name predicate. Other divine words, ordinary words and phrases remain included.
scoring.all_words: Report inclusive counts separately, plus complete per-type tables. Overlapping windows and lengths are not independent evidence.

comparison.population: Only complete eligible rows under unchanged six-page interval feasibility rules, extended corpus-wide at the user's request. Full mapped geometry is reported separately and not assigned this subset's tail.
comparison.fixed: Actual text/order, page/row assignments, detector widths and outer row edges. Permute the observed nonnegative gap multiset independently within each eligible row. No phrase-identity relabeling or target-score optimization.
comparison.limitations: An exposed development spacing-sensitivity model, not a validated historical renderer. Inherits print widths and line breaks; omits glyph/marker ownership. Gap exchangeability is not independently validated. No origin likelihood.
comparison.multiple_tests: Bonferroni factor six for the six primary non-Allah-form length metrics; report unadjusted and adjusted plus-one MC summaries. No individual-type significance claims or multiplication of tails.

sensitivity: Require every constituent's normalized OCR surface to match the exact canonical form, using the frozen exact-surface view; report descriptive outcomes without refitting or new simulations.
diagnostics: For each length, select earliest six aligned non-Allah-form pairs with distinct identities and pages, plus earliest two unpaired non-Allah-form occurrences on other pages. Inspect scan-backed side-by-side crops as exposed diagnostics, not fresh annotation. Report unpaired counts and full per-type outcomes, including failures.
completion: Finish the full exact-word/phrase inventory, coherence-preserving spacing comparison, independent small-ground-truth tests, replay, scan diagnostics and origin assessment. Do not extrapolate spacing tails into divinity probabilities.
